test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the main challenge facing the adoption of renewable energy?

options.text: Lack of skilled labour for the production of renewable energy
Abundance of fossil fuels in the world
Cost of renewable energy is currently higher than traditional fossil fuels

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One of the main challenges facing the adoption of renewable energy is its higher cost compared to traditional fossil fuels.
 
• Although renewable energy has clear environmental benefits, the initial investment and infrastructure costs are significant.
 
• As technology advances and economies of scale are achieved, the cost of renewable energy is expected to decrease.
 
• Reliable and efficient energy storage solutions are also required for the widespread adoption of renewable energy.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Incorrect - The lack of skilled labor is not a primary challenge for renewable energy adoption.
 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect - While fossil fuels are still abundant, their environmental impact makes renewable energy necessary.
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect - There is a growing demand for renewable energy due to environmental concerns.
